title: AsyncOpSyndicationFeedFile - Data API
description: Represents the sync status of file-related information shared with external channels such as Facebook and Instagram. This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

AsyncOpSyndicationFeedFileNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
AsyncOpSyndicationFeedFileNumber.description: ID assigned to each syndication feed file record, and used for tracking and reference purposes.

AsyncOperationTrackerId.description: ID assigned to the Async Operation Tracker record, which monitors and manages the lifecycle of the syndication process. This field is a relationship field.

FeedContentBody.description: The content of the feed file that is syndicated to the external platform.

FeedContentContentType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
FeedContentContentType.description: Specifies the format of the feed file to ensure proper processing. For example, CSV, JSON, or XML files.

FeedContentLength.description: The size of the feed file in bytes, which is used for validation and processing requirements.

FeedContentName.description: The name of the feed file, which includes identifiers like timestamp or sequence number.

FeedScope.description: Defines the scope or category of the feed. For example, if the feed applies to main, country-specific, or language-specific catalog segments. Possible values are: CountryFeed LanguageFeed MainFeed

PlatformConnections.description: The external channel or destination for syndication. Possible values are: Meta

SyncMode.description: Specifies the type of sync being performed. Possible values are: FullSync
